bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/shared-menu-a1b687d-20261115"
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:shared-a1b687d)" || exit 61
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
row="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT count(DISTINCT chat_id) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' AND state='published' AND chat_id=ANY(ARRAY[-1003847210571,-1002373696859,-1003770334893]::bigint[])" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | head -n1)" || exit 62
echo PUBLISHED_POSTING_PANEL_COUNT="$row"
test "$row" = 3 && exit 0
test "$row" = 2 && exit 82
exit 83
